people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
translations.bsb: Joseph is a fruitful vine— a fruitful vine by a spring, whose branches scale the wall.
translations.kjv: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
translations.asv: Joseph is a fruitful bough, A fruitful bough by a fountain; His branches run over the wall.
